column7: 22 core entry points (secret auto-rotate/rotate/rollback/copy/move/tags/description, share revoke, environment clone/copy-secrets, role update/delete/permission add, user create (+assignments), user role set, group restore/role assign/member add, project restore, global invitation, bulk access-request approve) did not check the permission their REST route group and gRPC method check first (roles.read, users.read, per-secret secrets.write, ...), so a direct core call succeeded where both transports refuse (authzdiff waiver known-04, 4526 cases). Fixed in core with one primitive and one gate per family (internal/core/route_gate.go); waiver known-04 removed.
